summary: The earlier not-comparable reason holds only for inference. BMC Genomics Additional file 2 (sheet DEG) lists all 13,856 author-tested genes with a per-timepoint SD-vs-SS effect, SDvsSS_6hr.FC, which is the same contrast and orientation as the registered ZT6 track. The 52 GEO samples match the paper's 52 mice, and the 12 ZT6 libraries are the registered cohort. Joining exact Ensembl IDs through the registered feature map gives 13,184 pairs (95.15% of author rows, 99.27% of registered rows): Pearson 0.944669, Spearman 0.958157, direction agreement 95.00%, median absolute log2FC difference 0.014146. This passes author-concordance-v2 on both routes. The author FDR is a 4-timepoint moderated-F test, not a ZT6 test, so inference stays not assessed.

manualReview.summary: Full author ZT6 effects agree with the registered sleep-deprivation output
manualReview.note: The official raw-count matrix and SOFT match the SHA-256 values documented in the dataset README. The paper's headline 263 DEGs come from a limma moderated F-test pooling the four SD-versus-SS timepoints, which is not the registered ZT6 estimand. However, BMC Genomics Additional file 2 (12864_2020_7050_MOESM2_ESM.xlsx, SHA-256 2600a3b7..., sheet DEG) lists all 13,856 author-tested genes with separate per-timepoint SD-vs-SS effects. Its SDvsSS_6hr.FC column is the registered contrast in the same orientation. GEO lists 52 samples, matching the paper's 52 mice, with exactly 6 SS6hr and 6 SD6hr libraries at ZT6; these are the 12 registered libraries. The author fit uses all 52 samples with shared TMM normalization and limma variance moderation, while the registered edgeR-QL fit uses only the 12 ZT6 libraries. Author Ensembl IDs were joined exactly through the registered feature map (SHA-256 afa3efb8..., as recorded in provenance); 374 IDs without a current symbol and 15 IDs whose symbol is summed over several features were excluded, with no symbol renaming. Against the current registered DE table (SHA-256 5fb5171c...), 13,184 pairs (95.15% of 13,856 author rows; 99.27% of 13,281 registered rows) give Pearson 0.944669, Spearman 0.958157, direction agreement 95.00% (12,525/13,184), median absolute log2FC difference 0.014146 and paired RMS effect ratio 0.901098. All 258 paired author F-test DEGs agree in direction (Pearson 0.986937). Another 283 author genes have no registered row because the expression filters differ. The author FC column is read as a limma log2 coefficient. No author ZT6 P/FDR is reported, so inference is not assessed. Evidence and reproducible extraction are in continued-sources/GSE132308/turbo-2026-11-16-wave2/.

comparabilityReview.criteria: author-concordance-v2 on exact Ensembl joins with finite effects: at least 30 pairs, at least 90% coverage, Pearson and Spearman at least 0.90 or direction agreement at least 90%. No threshold, exclusion or mapping tuning; inference is not compared.
comparabilityReview.conclusion: Full-table author ZT6 effects agree with the registered output by correlation and direction. ZT6 inference and the whole-cohort versus ZT6-only estimator difference remain unassessed.
